title: Shanghai Labourers Club

G. 25,000-1-34

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.1, Special Branch
REPORT
Date... 7.1.1934

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY. 5758）

Subject (in full)........................................ Shanghai Labourers' Club.

Made by... D. S. Mac Adie ............ Forwarded by... Whouman DSD

The Shanghai Labourers' Club, 545 Kiukiang
Road, which was formed by the General Labour Union, is
also supported by the local Kuomintang. It is
reported that the club receives a regular monthly subsidy
of $300.00 from the local Tangpu from the monthly fund
granted by the Central Kuomintang to facilitate
activities of people's organizations in Shanghai.

R W Mac Adie
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

D.C. (Cromi)
Information
Thos Robertson
tckt

事由（全称）........................................ 上海劳工俱乐部。

呈报人……D. S. Mac Adie ............ 转呈人……Whouman DSD

位于九江路545号的上海劳工俱乐部由总工会组建，亦得到当地国民党的支持。据报，该俱乐部每月从当地党部获得300.00美元的定期补贴，该款项出自中央国民党为便利上海民众团体活动而拨付的月度基金。

R W Mac Adie

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.1, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date May 5 / 10 34

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. S. B. REGISTRY.
5758
Date 5 / 10 34）

Subject (in full) Shanghai Labourers' Club - to be used as a base for
fomenting labour unrest.

Made by D. S. Mac Adie Forwarded by W Duncan DS

According to information collected among local
labour circles, the Shanghai Labourers' Club organized by
members of the General Labour Union ostensibly for
amusement purposes is to serve as a secret meeting place
of labourers of any trade during periods of unrest or
strikes. The existence of the Dah Kung News Agency,
an organ also promoted by the General Labour Union with
offices in the same building, where the club is located,
serves to eliminate the presence of other press men who
might be interested in secret activities of the Club.

R W Mac adie.
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

D.C. (Crime)
This information is
more or less indicated
in my report on
application for club licence.
J H Robertson

FILE
JR

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S.1，特别股。
报告
日期 1934年5月5 / 10日

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案号 特别股登记处。
5758
日期 1934年5 / 10日）

事由（全称）上海劳工俱乐部——将被用作煽动劳工动荡的基地。

呈报人 D. S. Mac Adie 转呈人 W Duncan DS

根据在当地劳工界收集的情报，由总工会成员组织、表面上以娱乐为目的的上海劳工俱乐部，旨在成为动荡或罢工期间各行业劳工的秘密集会场所。大公通讯社的存在——这也是由总工会推动的一个机构，其办事处与俱乐部位于同一栋建筑内——有助于排除其他可能对俱乐部秘密活动感兴趣的新闻界人士。

R W Mac adie.
D. S.

特别股主管警官。

D.C. (刑事)
此情报在我关于
申请俱乐部执照的
报告中已有大致提及。
J H Robertson

归档
JR

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. I, Special Branch
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY. No. D 5758 Date March 26, 1934. Date 26/3/34）

Subject (in full) Shanghai Labourers' Club - Inaugurated.

Made by D. S. Mac Adie Forwarded by Whouman D.S.

（左侧批注：See File D. 2985）

The "Shanghai Labourers' Club" promoted by
the General Labour Union was formally inaugurated in its
premises at 545 Kiukiang Road, on March 25. This
club occupies the second floor of the building and has
been formed for the mutual entertainment and convenience
of members of local labour unions registered with the
local Kuomintang. Alcoholic liquors may be obtained
on the premises. In the opinion of the undersigned,
the organization comes within the category of a Chinese
club and as such should have a Municipal licence which
as yet has not been applied for.

R. W. Mac Adie
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（底部手写批注：）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S. I，特别股
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 刑事与特别股登记处。编号 D 5758 日期 1934年3月26日。日期 1934年3月26日）

事由（全称）上海劳工俱乐部——成立。

呈报人 D. S. Mac Adie 转呈人 Whouman D.S.

（左侧批注：见档案 D. 2985）

由总工会推动的“上海劳工俱乐部”于3月25日在九江路545号的址所正式成立。该俱乐部占据该建筑的二楼，系为已在当地国民党注册的当地工会会员提供相互娱乐及便利而设立。场内可提供酒精饮料。在下认为，该组织属于华人俱乐部类别，因此应持有工部局执照，但迄今尚未提出申请。

R. W. Mac Adie
D. S.

特别股主管警官。

（底部手写批注：）
51
保持与九江路545号的联系
已通过
转交至 D O "A"。此
报告可转交
登记处。归档
（签名）
M Steel
1934年3月26日
